meta.description: Full-stack React SPA that tracks construction projects, configures per-project insurance limits, scans ACORD 25 COIs via Gemini AI, and manages subcontractor compliance. Multi-tenant on Supabase with Row-Level Security; deployed on Vercel.

layers.label: Entry / Shell
layers.blurb: Bootstraps React, gates on auth, provides settings.

layers.label: State / Context
layers.blurb: React context providers holding session + org settings.

layers.label: Views & Components
layers.blurb: The App shell and every screen, modal, and drawer.

layers.label: Domain Logic
layers.blurb: Pure, testable business rules (compliance, trades, vendors).

layers.label: Data Services
layers.blurb: Async data layer talking to Supabase; single swap point.

layers.label: Server / AI API
layers.blurb: Express (dev) + Vercel functions that call Gemini to read documents.

layers.label: Supabase Backend
layers.blurb: Postgres w/ RLS, Auth, and a scheduled edge function.

nodes.label: main.tsx
nodes.role: React entrypoint. Mounts <AuthProvider><Root/></AuthProvider> into #root and imports global CSS.

nodes.label: Root.tsx
nodes.role: Top-level auth gate. Shows a loader while the session resolves, the LoginScreen when signed out, and <SettingsProvider><App/></SettingsProvider> when signed in.

nodes.label: AuthContext
nodes.role: Holds the Supabase auth session + user; exposes signIn / signUp / signOut. Subscribes to onAuthStateChange and clears the org-id cache on sign-out.

nodes.label: SettingsContext
nodes.role: Loads org AppSettings once and shares them app-wide. Blocks children until loaded; updateSettings is optimistic and persists via settingsService.

nodes.label: App.tsx
nodes.role: Central orchestrator. Owns all in-memory record state (projects, subcontractors, notifications, active-COI map), the Home/Projects/Vendors view switch, and every CRUD handler. Wires all modals and drawers.

nodes.label: LoginScreen
nodes.role: Email/password sign-in and sign-up form. Handles the 'check your email' confirmation state.

nodes.label: DashboardStats
nodes.role: Home KPI row: active projects, subcontractor count, compliance rate %, flagged (expired/insufficient) count.

nodes.label: NeedsAttention
nodes.role: Cross-project triage worklist. Buckets subs into expired / insufficient / expiring-soon / missing and offers jump-to-project or upload actions.

nodes.label: NotificationList
nodes.role: Notifications feed. Opens a draft-email composer (from templates, token-substituted) the user can copy.

nodes.label: VendorsView
nodes.role: Cross-project vendor roll-up. Groups the same company across projects, sortable by attention / name / project count.

nodes.label: ProjectForm
nodes.role: Create/edit a project: coverage baselines, warn-days, custom requirements, additional-insured, endorsements. Can scan a prime-contract exhibit to pre-fill baselines.

nodes.label: SubcontractorModal
nodes.role: Enroll a subcontractor/supplier: company, trade (from configurable list), contract value, and optional vendor contact.

nodes.label: VerificationDrawer
nodes.role: Split-screen compliance reviewer. Runs verifyCompliance live on the extracted values (editable), shows the pass/fail matrix beside the rendered document, and captures manual overrides / waivers on save.

nodes.label: CoiUploadZone
nodes.role: Drag-and-drop COI uploader. Posts the file to /api/scan-coi and hands the extracted payload back to App. Also offers manual entry and sandbox samples.

nodes.label: DocumentViewer
nodes.role: Renders the uploaded PDF/image with pdf.js and overlays bounding boxes for extracted ACORD 25 fields using a deterministic field template.

nodes.label: SettingsModal
nodes.role: Tabbed settings: org default requirements, trade labels, trade coverage rules, email templates, evaluation date, reminder cadence, org name + user profile/password, and data export/import/clear/seed.

nodes.label: CoiHistoryDrawer
nodes.role: Per-subcontractor COI timeline. Lists every certificate on file and lets you inspect a prior policy year's extracted values.

nodes.label: ExecutivePrintReport
nodes.role: Print-only compliance ledger for a project (window.print()). Hidden on screen; shown in the print stylesheet.

nodes.label: UserGuideModal
nodes.role: In-app help: tabbed walkthrough of project setup, certificate parsing, exclusions/waivers, and exporting.

nodes.label: CurrencyInput
nodes.role: Reusable USD text field that formats digits as '$1,250,000' live while preserving the caret.

nodes.label: complianceEngine
nodes.role: The COI verification engine. verifyCompliance() checks a certificate against project + trade requirements and returns {status, errors}. Hard-fail limit shortfalls, WC, claims-made GL, expiration; advisory-only for insured-name, additional-insured, and endorsements. Covered by complianceEngine.test.ts (595 lines).

nodes.label: tradeRules
nodes.role: resolveRequiredCoverage(): the effective umbrella/professional/pollution minimum is max(project baseline, trade rule). Trade rules ship empty and can only raise, never lower.

nodes.label: vendors
nodes.role: buildVendorSummaries(): groups subcontractor records by a normalized company key across projects, rolls up worst status + earliest expiration + total contract value.

nodes.label: currency
nodes.role: formatUSD(): Intl-based USD formatter ('$1,000,000', 0 decimals).

nodes.label: reportExporter
nodes.role: exportToCSV(): serializes a project's subcontractors to CSV and triggers a browser download.

nodes.label: types
nodes.role: Shared domain model: Project, ProjectRequirements, EndorsementRequirements/Facts, Subcontractor, CoiRecord, Notification, TradeType.

nodes.label: dbService
nodes.role: Supabase-backed data layer for projects, subcontractors, COI records, and notifications. submitCoiRecord() is the write hub: it re-runs verifyCompliance, writes the COI, updates sub status (honoring waivers), and raises notifications. Also export/import/clear/seed.

nodes.label: settingsService
nodes.role: Loads/saves org_settings and defines AppSettings + all built-in defaults (requirements, trades, templates, reminder cadence). todayISO() helper.

nodes.label: accountService
nodes.role: Org identity + the signed-in user's profile (orgs / profiles tables). Rename org (owner-only), edit own profile, change password.

nodes.label: supabaseClient
nodes.role: The shared Supabase browser client (URL + anon key from Vite env). currentOrgId() caches the user's org id for stamping inserts; RLS enforces scoping on read/update/delete.

nodes.label: server.ts
nodes.role: Local Express dev server. Serves the Vite SPA in middleware mode and exposes POST /api/scan-coi and /api/scan-contract, delegating to the shared scan logic.

nodes.label: api/scan-coi
nodes.role: Vercel serverless function POST /api/scan-coi (maxDuration 60s). Thin wrapper over scanCoi().

nodes.label: api/scan-contract
nodes.role: Vercel serverless function POST /api/scan-contract. Thin wrapper over scanContract().

nodes.label: api/_scan
nodes.role: Shared Gemini scanning logic. scanCoi() reads an ACORD 25 into structured limits + endorsement facts; scanContract() reads a prime-contract exhibit into project baselines. FAILS CLOSED — never fabricates data; only named sandbox sample files return canned extractions.

nodes.label: Postgres + RLS
nodes.role: Multi-tenant schema. Every table is org-scoped by RLS via current_org_id(). Tables: orgs, profiles, org_settings, projects, subcontractors, coi_records, notifications, coi_reminder_log. 7 migrations (init → endorsements).

nodes.label: Supabase Auth
nodes.role: Email/password auth. A handle_new_user() SECURITY DEFINER trigger bootstraps tenancy: the first signup creates the org + org_settings + owner profile; later signups join as members.

nodes.label: send-expiry-reminders
nodes.role: Daily pg_cron edge function (Deno). Uses the service-role key to bypass RLS and iterate every org; finds each sub's latest COI, buckets it (30/7/expired), and fires in-app + optional email notices. Idempotent via the coi_reminder_log unique index.

nodes.label: @supabase/supabase-js
nodes.role: Supabase client SDK — DB queries + Auth from the browser and the edge function.

nodes.label: Google Gemini 3.5 Flash
nodes.role: Multimodal LLM. Extracts structured insurance data from certificate images/PDFs and contract exhibits under a strict response schema.

nodes.label: Resend
nodes.role: Transactional email provider for the reminder engine's optional email channel. Off unless RESEND_API_KEY + REMINDER_FROM_EMAIL are set.

nodes.label: Vercel
nodes.role: Production host. Builds the Vite SPA to /dist, serves /api/* as serverless functions, and rewrites all non-API routes to index.html (SPA).

tables.name: orgs
tables.rls: read own (id = current_org_id()); update own (owner only)

columns.name: compliance_status
columns.note: Compliant | Insufficient | Expired | Pending | Approved Exception

tables.name: coi_reminder_log
tables.rls: read own; writes only from the edge function
tables.note: UNIQUE(coi_record_id, bucket, channel, recipient) — idempotency backstop for the daily run.

flows.title: Auth & single-org bootstrap
steps: User submits LoginScreen (sign up or sign in) → supabase.auth.
On first-ever signup, the handle_new_user() trigger (SECURITY DEFINER) runs on auth.users insert.
First user: create orgs row + org_settings + an 'owner' profile. Later users: join the existing org as 'member'.
AuthContext receives the session via onAuthStateChange.
Root sees a session → renders <SettingsProvider> which loads org_settings, then <App>.
App.loadIdentity() + loadAllData() hydrate org name, profile, and all org-scoped records.

flows.title: Upload → scan → verify → persist a COI
steps: In a project, the user clicks Upload/Re-Scan on a subcontractor → CoiUploadZone drawer opens.
Drag a certificate → POST /api/scan-coi with base64 file data.
scanCore (api/_scan) calls Gemini under a strict JSON schema — or returns canned data for named sandbox samples. Fails closed on any error (no fabricated values).
Extracted payload returns to App → VerificationDrawer opens beside the rendered document (DocumentViewer overlays field boxes).
verifyCompliance() runs live on the (editable) values → pass/fail matrix; the reviewer can override/waive.
On save → dbService.submitCoiRecord(): re-runs verifyCompliance, inserts coi_records, updates the subcontractor status (honoring active waivers), and creates a notification on errors.
App.loadAllData() refreshes the in-memory snapshot and every view updates.

flows.title: How verifyCompliance decides status
steps: resolveRequiredCoverage() = max(project baseline, trade rule) for umbrella / professional / pollution.

HARD checks (fail status): GL each-occurrence & aggregate, claims-made GL form, auto CSL, workers' comp, products-completed, umbrella, 3× employers' liability, professional, pollution, custom requirements, expiration.
ADVISORY checks (never fail; surface a 'verify' note): insured-name mismatch, additional-insured (named vs blanket), and opt-in endorsements (WOS / P&NC / per-project agg / completed-ops AI).
Final status: Expired if past the eval date; else Insufficient Coverage if any hard error remains; else Compliant.
A warning within the project's warn-days grace window is advisory (stays Compliant but is flagged).

flows.title: Scheduled COI-expiration reminders
steps: pg_cron triggers send-expiry-reminders daily (Deno edge function, service-role key → bypasses RLS).
For each org: read reminder_settings; skip if disabled.
For each subcontractor on an active project: find the latest COI with an expiration date.
pickBucket(days) maps the cert to a single step: 30 → 7 → expired (fires each once).
Assemble channels: in_app (team) always; email_team / email_vendor only if email_enabled AND provider configured.
Claim a coi_reminder_log slot (UNIQUE index = idempotent) → insert a notification and/or send via Resend; release the slot on delivery failure so the next run retries.

flows.title: Build & deploy topology
steps: Dev: `npm run dev` runs server.ts (Express + Vite middleware) on :3020, serving the SPA and /api/scan-* locally.
CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml): typecheck (tsc --noEmit) → vitest → vite build on every push/PR.
Prod: Vercel builds the Vite SPA to /dist; /api/* become serverless functions; all other routes rewrite to index.html.
Data + auth live in Supabase; the reminder edge function runs on Supabase's daily cron independent of the web host.
